rationale: The workflow already implements the applicable dependency-caching optimization: setup-python uses cache: 'pip' with cache-dependency-path: './doc/requirements.txt', which satisfies P-LIT-GHA-CACHE but is contraindicated because an equivalent cache already exists. It also already cancels superseded/in-progress runs via the workflow-level concurrency group ('pages', cancel-in-progress: true), satisfying P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE. No other pattern's preconditions are met: there is no matrix (P-LIT-FAIL-FAST), no schedule trigger (P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE/P-LIT-FAIL-SCHEDULE), no test suite to prioritize or select (P-LIT-PRIORITIZE/P-LIT-SELECT), no Bazel build (P-LIT-BAZEL-*), and no reliable successful-duration history exists in the CI context to set an informed custom timeout (P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT). The remaining uncached system dependency (doxygen via apt) has no corresponding supported evidence pattern, and adding an uncached apt cache mechanism would be unsupported by the retrieved evidence.
